title: Dispatch start_code_task rejects second session in same non-git directory since 2.1.258 (regression from 2.1.247)

environment.cwdKind: normal folder (not a git repo) containing ~14 git repositories

error: [DispatchTools] start_code_task failed for ~/Projects: Another Claude Code session is already active in this directory.
expected: Dispatch should be able to spawn multiple sessions into the same non-repo working directory, as it did through bundle 2.1.247 / app 1.40609.
workaround: Dispatching into an individual git repo folder (where a worktree can be created) still works. Cross-repo tasks that need the parent folder as cwd cannot be dispatched in parallel.
